dataset: Synthetic Benchmark Precipitation Scenarios for Hydrodynamic Model Testing
source: Algorithmic Design / Synthetic Hyetograph Generator based on Chicago and Huff Storm Distributions
license: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 - Public Domain Dedication)
spatial_resolution: Lumped uniform catchment forcing / spatial test input
temporal_resolution: 15 minutes across a 6-hour simulation window (24 timesteps)
quality: synthetic (Controlled boundary inputs for automated test suites)
limitations: STRICTLY FOR SOFTWARE BENCHMARKING, UNIT TESTING, AND SYSTEM VERIFICATION. Do NOT use as empirical meteorological observations.
processing: Generated using standard synthetic storm profile curves with peak convective pulses.
notes: Includes 5 scenarios: light_rain, moderate_rain, heavy_rain, extreme_rain, and cloudburst_pulse.
